provisional_reason: at least one run started or ended with the one-minute load average above 2.5 (25% of 10 CPUs); runs above it are marked, and no figure here is a quiet-host measurement unless every run says so
provider: scripted fake provider on loopback (replies at once, after 150 ms, or holds the stream); not model delay

config_notes.standard: capacity receipt 16, memory_units 262144, inspection 4, upstream 16, stream 16, default limits
config_notes.tight: capacity receipt 8, memory_units 16384, inspection 4, upstream 8, stream 4; max_connections 64, admission_wait_ms 250, admission_queue 16

percentile_note: stage percentiles under load come from the gateway's log-bucketed histograms and are bucket upper edges (at most 25% above the true value); sequential per-request figures are exact deltas
